concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-risk-management-configure-risk-settings]] — Adyen Customer Area risk-settings guide (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) for company and merchant overrides, basic/premium controls, company-wide Protect disablement, and live-only region migration.
warnings: Company-level Disable risk management turns off Protect for the company; merchant-account changes require explicit Override company settings.
Live region changes can affect legal/privacy/regulatory posture and await Support review; the 60-day replication sequence is Adyen's recommendation, not evidence of completed migration.
